method.drought_candidate: A binary drought candidate uses a crop-specific percentile cutoff of administrative-unit total growing-season precipitation selected by 10-fold cross-validation; it is not part of the published final maize specification.
method.extreme_rain_candidate: Amount and day-count candidates above the grid-cell 1980-2010 daily precipitation 95th percentile were evaluated but are not part of the published final maize specification.
method.final_selection: The second cross-validation step selects phased versus total-season precipitation; maize retains phased precipitation.
method.phase_selection: Nested F-tests compare marginal precipitation effects at 100, 300, and 500 mm, proceeding from each end of the season; p < 0.05 creates a phase break, with visual resolution when forward and reverse searches disagree.
method.precipitation_aggregation: Daily precipitation is summed to grid-cell month before polynomial transformation; transformed monthly terms are then aligned to fixed crop growing seasons and phase groups.
